With reference to the show cause notice and rejection letter cited above
reference 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 & 6 concerning the supply of Cow Ghee, we hereby
submit our detailed response as follows:

## 1. Denial of Allegations

We unequivocally deny all allegations of adulteration and the charges
levied against our company. M/s A.R Dairy Food Private Limited,
Milk adheres to the highest standards of quality and holds
certifications including ISO 22000:2018, Our company has an
annual turnover of Rs. 200 crore and employs 500 staff members,
reflecting our commitment to maintaining exceptional quality.

## 2. Quality Assurance

We take extensive measures to ensure that all products dispatched
from our facilities meet stringent quality standards.



*DANDI GUIL

## 3. Dispute of Sample Collection

We believe that the sample collected by your representatives was not
handled correctly. The impugned sample should have included four
parts for accurate analysis. Additionally, the analytical lab report
from NDDB CALF Ltd was not enclosed with the notice, which
challenges the validity of the charges against us. Furthermore, the
sampling methodology was not detailed in the notice. We were not
given an opportunity to defend our position before being blacklisted
and publicly defamed. Our factory has maintained a high reputation
for 35 years.

## 4. Consistency of Results

The ghee in question, loaded in two vehicles (ie AP26 TC 4779 &
TN02 BA 9459), originated from the same batch. However, the test
results from NDDB CALF varied between the two samples. This
inconsistency raises questions about the reliability of the analysis,
further the other NDDB CALF reports relating to the remaining two
vehicles (ie TN02 BB 2070 & TN02 BB 2151) also failed to follow the
procedure of sampling taken method.

## 11. Adjudication and Sampling

We were not involved in the adjudication process or in taking fresh
samples from the tankers. Therefore, our rights to natural justice
were compromised.

In light of the above, we respectfully request that a fresh consignment
be allowed to replace the disputed one, in accordance with Clause 57 of the
agreement. We propose that new samples be taken one to be sent to an
FSSAI lab and the other to your lab. We assure you of our commitment to
the quality of products, especially those consumed as Prasadham.

We look forward to your favourable consideration of our request.
